title: Winter and Well
author: Astrid Amberdale
blurb: Marguerite Iversen, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
